model.quantization: EXL3 K5/K6 with quantized MTP head and BF16 embeddings/vision tower

runtime.image_status: public clean-checkout local image builder; no published image
runtime.builder_status: experimental; offline-validated; TP2 image launch pending

serving.sizing_note: The normalized pair serves a 1048576-token limit with 32 maximum sequences. The measured launch reported 4130233 logical key-value tokens, enough for 3.94 full-length request footprints before generated-token headroom.

evidence.conditions: Two directly cabled NVIDIA DGX Sparks used the pinned checkpoint and maintainer-built source runtime at TP2/DCP1, a 1000000-token static-YaRN request limit, 32 sequences, an 8192-token scheduler budget, chunked prefill, asynchronous scheduling, full-input-length reservation, aligned 1600-token attention/mamba pages, FP8 key-value cache, native prefix caching, TRITON_ATTN target/draft attention, TORCH_SDPA multimodal attention, full-decode CUDA graphs, FP8 EXL3 prefill with reconstruction tile 256, Qwen parsers, and probabilistic Qwen MTP depth 3. LMCache, SparkCache, and SIRCL were disabled.
evidence.measurement: Startup and capacity came from engine logs. Functional probes exercised API health, deterministic arithmetic, tool parsing, data-URL vision, shared-prefix divergence, repeated-prefix equality, and one temperature-1 probabilistic-MTP request.
evidence.result: Both ranks rendezvoused and served. The engine reported 67.96 GiB of available key-value memory per rank, 4093750 logical key-value tokens, and 4.09x maximum concurrency at 1000000 tokens. A temperature-1 probe accepted 85 of 126 draft tokens over 42 speculative steps, for 67.5% draft acceptance and 3.02 mean acceptance length.
evidence.conclusion: The maintainer-built TP2 serving object is implemented as a research profile. No throughput result, 1M-input correctness result, or public-image live gate is published.
limitations: Static YaRN can change short-context output distributions relative to the native 262144-token profile.
No one-million-token request or temperature-1 performance result is published for this profile.
The public image builder has offline validation only and has not reproduced this TP2 launch.
The launch has no restart, reboot-persistence, or long-duration reliability evidence.
SIRCL and external key-value caching are not part of the profile.
